title: Claim-Handling Charge, Northgate Protect Standard Plan Refunds
content:
**Charge.** A claim-handling charge comes off the Northgate Protect Standard plan cancellation refund by the claims filed on the plan: the many-claims charge of $15.00 at 3 claims or more, the few-claims charge of $7.50 for one claim up to below 3, and nothing with no claim.

| Claims filed on the plan | Charge |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | $15.00 |
| 1 or 2 | $7.50 |
| None | Nothing |

Every claim filed on the plan counts, whatever its decision. *Hypothetical:* a plan with two claims filed, one approved and one denied, carries $7.50; a third claim filed raises the charge to $15.00.
